HOW URA CALCULATES YOUR TAXES

All taxes are levied under the East African Community Common External Tariff (EAC-CET) and collected by the Uganda Revenue Authority (URA). Tax rates verified against real URA output data.

CALCULATION CHAIN
LEGAL BASIS & RATES
IMPORT DUTY
EAC Common External Tariff · HS Code 8703.xx · Rate: 25%
VAT
VAT Act · Applied on CIF + Import Duty · Rate: 18%
WITHHOLDING TAX
Income Tax Act · Applied on CIF · Rate: 6%
INFRASTRUCTURE LEVY
Finance Act 2014 · Road fund · Applied on CIF · Rate: 1.5%
ENVIRONMENTAL LEVY
Finance Act · 0–8 years: 0% · 9–14 years: 50% of CIF
FIXED GOV'T FEES (UGX)
Form 18k · Stamp 35k · Excise 200k · Registration 1.5M
WHAT IS CIF?

CIF = Cost + Insurance + Freight. URA taxes your vehicle on its CIF value. If your purchase price is lower than URA's Motor Vehicle Value Guide, URA will use their value — not yours.
